title: Hilltop Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Hilltop Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings presentation (Exhibit 99.1) pursuant to Regulation FD. The company plans to use the presentation in investor meetings and a webcast on April 24, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. CT.
key_points: Hilltop Holdings is a Maryland corporation headquartered in Dallas, Texas, trading as HTH on NYSE and NYSE Texas.
The filing is dated April 23, 2026, with the earliest event reported being the same date.
Exhibit 99.1 contains the First Quarter 2026 Earnings Presentation, furnished under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure).
A public webcast to present the earnings material is scheduled for April 24, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. central time.
The filing explicitly states the information is not deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act.
Signed by Corey G. Prestidge, Executive Vice President, General Counsel & Secretary.
